title: Type byte bit layout undocumented in encode()
description:
File: rust/lichen-gateway/src/discovery.rs
Line: 248

```rust
buf[0] = GATEWAY_FLAG | 0x01; // Type byte: GATEWAY flag + announce type
```

The comment says 'announce type' is 0x01 but this is not documented in the struct's doc comment. The doc comment at lines 203-215 says 'bits 0-6 = reserved' but the code uses bit 0.

Either:
1. Document that 0x01 is the announce type value, or
2. Add a const ANNOUNCE_TYPE: u8 = 0x01 with doc comment

This affects decode() too - it should potentially validate the lower bits match expected announce type.
